description: Deploy an owned Felix-generated strategy by strategy_id as a live agent by default. markets binds every open to one of 1-4 owner-selected instruments and should match the backtest. Stop loss and other server-monitored exits are optional on Hyperliquid and Derive; omit them to let the strategy manage exits. Polymarket does not support server exit plans, so omit those fields and let the strategy or market resolution close exposure. If a requested supported exit plan cannot be armed after a fill, Felix pauses and attempts a reduce-only unwind. Hyperliquid leverage is blocked unless allow_leverage:true is explicit. Set mode:paper explicitly to simulate. Live supports Hyperliquid, Derive, and Polymarket through venue-scoped execution signing. A Polymarket binding such as btc-updown-5m authorizes only its current timestamped child. See felix://strategy/ctx-api for the think(ctx) contract. Pass idempotency_key to make a retry safe.

acknowledge_unvalidated.description: Explicitly acknowledge missing or degraded replay evidence when deploying live.

allow_leverage.description: Explicitly permit a live Hyperliquid perp agent to exceed free collateral. Omitted or false blocks leveraged exposure before signing.

break_even_after_pct.description: Optional profit fraction that activates a break-even exit.

confirmed_budget_usd.description: Required for live mode only: USD capital reviewed by the owner; must match budget_usd at cents. Never derive this confirmation from a generic yes.

cycle_seconds.description: Loop interval. Polymarket supports 5-86400 seconds; other venues support 30-86400 seconds.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry-safety key. Reuse it to recover an interrupted deployment without creating a second agent.

markets.description: One to four owner-authorized instruments. Every live open outside this list fails before signing.

max_daily_loss_usd.description: Explicit daily-loss ceiling. Omit or use null for no selected agent limit; live key caps still apply.

max_holding_minutes.description: Optional maximum position age in minutes.

max_position_usd.description: Explicit position ceiling. Omit or use null for no selected agent limit; live key caps still apply.

mode.description: paper|live. Defaults to live; set paper explicitly to simulate.

replay_attestation.description: Replay attestation token returned by backtest for this exact strategy.

stop_loss_pct.description: Optional server-monitored hard-stop loss fraction for Hyperliquid and Derive agents, e.g. 0.05 for 5%. Omit it to run without a server stop.

strategy_id.description: Owned strategy UUID returned by generate_strategy.

trailing_activation_pct.description: Optional profit fraction before the trailing stop arms.

venue.description: Optional preferred venue, e.g. hyperliquid, polymarket.

name: deploy_agent
